newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia up sharply, seen technically strong.
newsitem.headline: Nokia up sharply, seen technically strong.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecoms major Nokia rose sharply on Wednesday on technical factors after breaking an important 340 markka resistance level, brokers said.

The 340-markka formed an important psychological barrier since that is where Nokia peaked in September 1995 before turning into a sharp decline, and brokers said there was now scope for further gains, although there was no new information in the market.
At 1535/1235 GMT, Nokia traded at 347.50, up 12.40 markka or four percent, and volume was a healthy 250 million markka.

Petri Korpineva, managing director at technical analysis firm Delphi Economics Finland, said Nokia breached an important level already at 300 in April, and has an upside to 500 markka, based on analysing moving averages and trade volume, but rising above the 340 level was also important.
"In all, Nokia looks strong," Korpineva said.
Nokia started rising notably after reporting first quarter earnings near the highest forecasts, but brief attempts at breaking though 340 markka had failed until Wednesday.
